ts.sec: Proposing informal competitor calls for security risk disclosure

turns.en: So you're basically saying, you know, whether it's Demis' proposal or others, you need to get together and get this set up now. It sounds like you're telling me.
turns.zh: 所以，你基本上是在说，无论是 Demis 的提议还是其他人的，你们需要现在就聚在一起把事情安排起来。听起来你是在告诉我这个。

turns.en: Yeah. I would recommend that we at least have some sort of informal group, you know, weekly or bi-weekly call. And that, like I said, just that there's maybe a week or two weeks of early access by competitors. And this is why I think the incentives work, because competing companies, I think, are likely to understand if something is a security risk, and they're not going to be shy about highlighting that their competitor's models should be delayed in release.
turns.zh: 是的。我会建议我们至少进行某种非正式的群体通话，比如每周或每两周一次。而且，就像我说的，竞争对手可以提前一两个星期获得早期访问权限。我认为这就是激励起作用的原因，因为我觉得竞争公司很可能能够理解某件事是否构成安全风险，而且他们不会羞于指出竞争对手的模型应该推迟发布。

ts.sec: Personal animosity and possibility of cooperation

turns.en: You guys don't much like each other and you don't much trust each other. You're insulting each other on social media constantly. So, do you think you can do that with people that you dislike, where there seems to be such kind of personal vitriol between some of these leaders?
turns.zh: 你们彼此不太喜欢对方，也不太信任对方。你们经常在社交媒体上互相辱骂。那么，你觉得你能和那些你不喜欢的人做到这一点吗？在这些领导者之间似乎存在着这种个人仇恨。

turns.en: Yes. Well, I'm not a fan of Sam Altman because if you started a nonprofit that was meant to be an open-source AI company, you know, owned by the world, and it somehow got turned into an $800 billion for-profit company with closed source. I think you'd be like, 'Well, wait a second, that's the exact opposite of what I donated the money for.' That's my issue. I think it's a legitimate one. And then Dario, I think, also is not a fan of Sam Altman because he felt—in fact, the reason the Anthropic team left OpenAI is because they didn't trust Sam Altman; otherwise, Anthropic wouldn't exist. They would still be at OpenAI. I think Dario is a very principled person. He cares about things a lot, cares about the future of the world. And I think everyone I've met at Anthropic so far—no one set off my evil detector. You know, they always seem like they're well-intentioned. And the road to hell is, I think, mostly paved with bad intentions. There are a few well-intentioned paving stones in there, so we don't want to be complacent. But at the end of the day, if we have to talk, we'll talk. I mean, set aside our personal differences for the good of the world type of thing.
turns.zh: 是的。嗯，我不是 Sam Altman 的粉丝，因为你创办了一个旨在成为开源 AI 公司的非营利组织，你知道，本应由全世界拥有，结果不知怎么变成了一个价值 8000 亿美元、拥有闭源的营利性公司。我觉得你会想，“等等，这和我捐钱的初衷完全相反。”这就是我的问题。我认为这是一个合理的问题。然后我觉得 Dario 也不是 Sam Altman 的粉丝，因为他觉得——事实上，Anthropic 团队离开 OpenAI 的原因就是他们不信任 Sam Altman；否则 Anthropic 就不会存在，他们还会留在 OpenAI。我认为 Dario 是一个非常讲原则的人。他非常关心很多事情，关心世界的未来。而且，到目前为止，我见过的每一位 Anthropic 的人，都没有触发我的“坏人探测器”。你知道，他们看起来总是心怀善意。通往地狱的道路，我认为大部分是由恶意铺成的，但其中也有几块善意的铺路石，所以我们不能自满。但说到底，如果必须谈，我们就会谈。我的意思是，为了世界的利益，把个人分歧放在一边的那种做法。

consensus.en: Superintelligence likely emerges in around five years, exceeding the sum of human intelligence.
consensus.zh: 超级智能大概五年内出现，超过人类智能总和。

consensus.en: The most probable outcome is an age of amazing abundance where anyone can have anything.
consensus.zh: 最可能的结果是惊人丰裕的时代，人人都能心想事成。

consensus.en: Humans won't remain in control once AI's intelligence vastly surpasses ours, like chimpanzees.
consensus.zh: 一旦AI智能远超人类，我们将失去控制权，就像黑猩猩一样。

consensus.en: There is no way to stop the incredible momentum of AI and robots.
consensus.zh: AI和机器人的发展势头无法阻挡。

consensus.en: Leading AI companies should hold regular calls to review each other's models for safety risks.
consensus.zh: 领先AI公司应定期通话，互相审查模型的安全风险。

consensus.en: Competitors have the technical insight and incentive to keep each other honest on releases.
consensus.zh: 竞争对手有技术洞察和动机，在模型发布上互相监督。

contrarian.en: Even if there were a stop button for AI, we probably shouldn't press it because the default outcome is abundance.
contrarian.zh: 即使有AI暂停按钮，我们也可能不该按，因为默认走向是丰裕。

contrarian.en: Existential risk from AI is acceptable as the universe's heat death renders all outcomes temporary.
contrarian.zh: AI的生存风险可以接受，因为宇宙热寂让一切结局都是暂时的。

contrarian.en: Trying to counter Google's AI monopoly by creating OpenAI inadvertently accelerated the entire field.
contrarian.zh: 试图抗衡谷歌的AI垄断而创建OpenAI，反而加速了整个领域的发展。

contrarian.en: Government regulators lack deep technical understanding to judge model releases, unlike rival companies.
contrarian.zh: 政府监管者缺乏判断模型发布所需的技术深度，不如竞争对手。

contrarian.en: A 10–20% chance of human extinction from AI is akin to riding a rocket with no alternative.
contrarian.zh: 10-20%的人类灭绝概率，就像明知火箭可能爆炸却别无选择。

contrarian.en: We need informal cooperation among AI leaders immediately, ideally within months, not half a year.
contrarian.zh: 我们需要AI领袖现在就开始非正式合作，最好数月内，而非半年。
